text_block_list.text: Huh?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's already this bright! Sorry, Mom, I'll
head out to the fields right
'way!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Wait a sec... this is...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: G-good morning.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Aaah?! An Umamusume! Wait, I mean...
Suzuka?! Huh? Um, I... What?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(Oh, that's right! Yesterday, I arrived in
Tokyo! Then I met Suzuka and
we ran
together! And after that...)
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
After that... I was totally shocked at how
big the academy is... then I
got all dizzy.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Suzuka. Just wondering, but... I
totally caused you a ton of
trouble, didn't
I?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Not really... I heard from the dorm leader
Fuji that you're my new
roommate, so I
figured I'd just carry you back with me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You carried me back?! Aaaahhhh! I'm
sorry—so, so sorry!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, but you said we're roommates?! That
makes me so happy! ...But I
feel super
sorry too! Aaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: U-um... are you okay?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Phew... Yeah. I feel much better after
washing my face! Sorry I made
such a
racket earlier, hehe...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
But can you blame me? Академия Тайсен is
seriously amazing! I mean,
even the dorm's
washrooms are ginormous!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Yes, well, there are two dorms, Ritto and
Miho, both of which are
divided into
several buildings.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Still, there really are a lot of students. If
we didn't have this much
room, we would
probably all be squished together.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I see! ...Ah, are those bottles over there all
tail-care products? There's
so many!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Exactly who is making all this noise this
early in the—Huh? Haven't
seen you
around before.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Ack, sorry! I-I'm Спешл Уик—I just
transferred here yesterday!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you're the one... I'm Эйр Грув, the
vice president of the
student council. I
heard you collapsed earlier. Are you all
right?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I-I'm f-f-fine! Your Excellency!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: I'm only a vice president.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Um. Спешл Уик, it's okay. She's actually
not that scary. Despite
how she appears...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
That's the most reassuring description you
can muster?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...Ah, forget it. In any case, you might want
to check out a mirror,
Спешл Уик. Your
tail is still a mess.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: It is?! S-sorry, Your Grace!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I told you, I'm just the vice president...
Honestly.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...Suzuka, can I ask you to give her a tour
of the place? After that,
show her to the
student council office. The president will
be waiting
there.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ah, sure... I can do that.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I know it's a lot of walking around, but
your leg is okay now, right?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh yeah, it's completely fine. I've
even started training again.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Is that so? How about registering for a
scrimmage, then? I remember
seeing quite
a few that lined up well with your
recovery.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Hm... Um, about that...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Wh-what?! What, what?! Sorry,
does anyone know how to
stop the dryer?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Sorry... I should go and help Спешл Уик.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Understood.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Okay, as for our tour... this is the cafeteria
here. They serve breakfast
and dinner
every day, which includes days off like
today...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Ah.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Urk. Sorry, I know you're in the middle of
explaining everything. But I
missed dinner
yesterday and can't bear the hunger
anymore...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Eh... Hehe... Hehehe!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: S-Suzuka?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ah, s-sorry. It's just... your belly gave you
away. I can't... Hehehe.
Hahaha!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Um... First off, let's grab
something to eat, then.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Okaaay...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
